import ctypes

def compute_canonical_permutation(n):
    if n < 1:
        raise ValueError("n must be >= 1")
    
    # Load the required libraries
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Define GSL permutation type and functions
    class gsl_permutation(ctypes.Structure):
        _fields_ = [("size", ctypes.c_size_t),
                   ("data", ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t))]
    
    gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_size_t]
    gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)
    
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free.restype = None
    
    gsl.gsl_permutation_init.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]
    gsl.gsl_permutation_init.restype = None
    
    gsl.gsl_permutation_linear_to_canonical.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation), ctypes.POINTER(gsl_permutation)]
    gsl.gsl_permutation_linear_to_canonical.restype = ctypes.c_int
    
    # Allocate and initialize linear permutation
    linear_perm = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(n)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_init(linear_perm)
    
    # Allocate memory for canonical permutation
    canon_perm = gsl.gsl_permutation_alloc(n)
    
    # Compute the canonical permutation
    result = gsl.gsl_permutation_linear_to_canonical(canon_perm, linear_perm)
    if result != 0:
        gsl.gsl_permutation_free(linear_perm)
        gsl.gsl_permutation_free(canon_perm)
        raise RuntimeError("GSL function returned error code: " + str(result))
    
    # Convert the result to a Python tuple
    output = tuple(canon_perm.contents.data[i] for i in range(n))
    
    # Free allocated memory
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free(linear_perm)
    gsl.gsl_permutation_free(canon_perm)
    
    return output
